Mr. Sanjay Kr. Srivastava, A.P.P.
---
05/16.02.2024 Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Special POCSO Case No.53 of 2023 arising out of Potka P.S. Case No.29 of 2023, for the offences registered under Sections 366A,
376(2)(n), 504 & 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4/6 of the POCSO Act, pending in the court of Sri Kanwal Jeet Chopra, learned Special Judge, Exclusive (POCSO) Court, Jamshedpur.
Petitioner is said to have established physical relationship with the victim on the pretext of marriage and thereafter, he recorded the intimate moment on his mobile phone.
From the perusal of the case diary, it appears that the mobile phone was recovered and the video recording was also available on the mobile phone of the petitioner.
However, from pleading of the written report, it appears that parties have entered into consensual sexual relationship.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail.
Considering the aforesaid fact, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/-(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Sri Kanwal Jeet Chopra, learned Special Judge, Exclusive (POCSO) Court, Jamshedpur or his successor in connection with Special POCSO Case No.53 of 2023 Dhananjay Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
